title: MEDICAL INTERPRETABILITY AND KNOWLEDGE MAPS OF LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS

bias_targets.methodology: Projecting intermediate layer activations into a 2D space using UMAP with prompts varying patient ages (from 1 to 100) to identify non-linearities and representational discontinuities (such as the split between subjects younger and older than 18).

Comparing the UMAP activation manifolds of age progression prompts using different gender identifiers ('he', 'she', 'someone') to observe how internal representations of demographics are gender-dependent.
